scope: Authored concept art only; no owner, model, rig, motion, gameplay, balance, device or shipping approval.
mandatory_threshold: Every mandatory gate plus each reference-sensitive dimension >=9.9; stronger exact10 requirements retained. Failed areas are not averaged away.

positive_observations: One-cell versus two-cell growth is substantial and easily read.
Raw receiving, cutting beds and plank outfeeds are visible.
Rear views are actual opposite views with input/output screen positions reversed coherently.
Timber/blue/orange family is retained; added footprint is justified by proposed capability.

mandatory_findings.gate: independent cell operation and safe staffing
mandatory_findings.observed: Both Parallel Sawmill cranks are mounted on the foreground bed fascia. The rear cutting cell has no legible independent drive or safe workstation.
mandatory_findings.repair: Show a separate mechanical drive and reachable operator position for each cutting cell, with shafts/linkage unambiguous in the function view and no approach crossing a cutting lane.

mandatory_findings.observed: The articulated output arm has a claw and joints but no hand winch, cable path or reachable manual actuation.
mandatory_findings.repair: Add the brief-required visible hand winch and coherent cable/linkage to the output-only arm; preserve clear operator and pedestrian space.

mandatory_findings.gate: selected resource identity and ordinary unit scale
mandatory_findings.observed: Finished output is rendered as loose broad flat plank stacks. The selected04 planks are a small ordinary bound plank unit. The r1 execution lacked selected04.
mandatory_findings.repair: Use selected04 for finished-unit identity and size; show intermediate cutting pieces only as processing contents, and a clear packing/collection point for actual output units.

evidence: Selected saw base previously inspected; selected04 reopened for direct comparison

positive_observations: Clear growth from compact house into receiving/dispatch warehouse then much larger logistics hall.
Recognizable central house facade retained in front exteriors.
Front central access apron and separated named receiving/dispatch zones show intended useful change.

mandatory_findings.observed: Both roof-off cutaways put the central front blue doors on the back wall. Both opposite rear exteriors have solid wall in that position.
mandatory_findings.repair: Remove false rear doors, retain a solid back wall and show the actual front facade peeled away/open with the original front doorway threshold. Preserve a walkable interior central aisle.

mandatory_findings.observed: The logistics hoist sits over an additional front-right ordinary-cargo tray beside fuel, detached from the brief front-left dispatch route. No useful hoist transfer path is visible.
mandatory_findings.repair: Place the hand hoist on a coherent receiving/stock/reserved-dispatch route, or explicitly author and approve a compatible separate loading job before depiction. Keep fuel and pedestrian aisle separate.

mandatory_findings.gate: real manual operation and cross-view mechanism
mandatory_findings.observed: Front hoist has large end wheels while cutaway changes to a central trolley; neither makes a reachable manual actuator and its working route clear.
mandatory_findings.repair: Show one consistent rail/trolley/hand-crank or pull-chain mechanism and reachable operating position in both views; safe travel cannot cut through the pedestrian aisle.

mandatory_findings.observed: Fuel is rendered as red cubes; source04 is an orange handled X-panel can. Generic jars and pink slabs also substitute for selected current goods.
mandatory_findings.repair: Use selected02/04 resource identities and ordinary size throughout. Keep old architecture reference for architecture, not superseded resource identities.

mandatory_findings.observed: Receiving is an exterior open bay but becomes a label above stocked shelves in the cutaway; true ingress and solid rear-wall relationships are not demonstrated.
mandatory_findings.repair: Fix one physical bay opening and show a clear incoming path to typed stock, distinct reserved outgoing positions and intact pedestrian route across all views.

evidence: Selected advanced storage/organization references previously inspected; selected04 reopened

next_action: Repair actual candidates then re-inspect whole boards plus meaningful mechanism/layout closeups; do not choose from prompts alone.
